concept: A list that refreshes when pulled down from the top, with a spinner in the gap it leaves and a button for anyone who cannot drag.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a refresh icon in the corner of a list, or a pull to refresh gesture with no alternative
default_to_avoid.why_not: a gesture alone fails WCAG 2.5.1; a corner button alone ignores how phones work

derivation.consequence: long ease-out curves (420 to 640ms) for arriving and hovering, a shorter one (200ms) for pressing because a press is a reply; under reduced motion every duration is zero at the token level
derivation.form: the list follows the finger at half its speed and settles back when the refresh is done

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: a Refresh button is always in the tree and shows when focused

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the spinner sits in the gap the list leaves, a lit arc in a groove

options: A pull with a focusable button
variants.picked: A pull with a focusable button
variants.reason: A works for touch and for keyboards (P6). B ignores the gesture people expect. C gives the reader no control.

root.why: the scrolling list, contained so the page behind does not bounce

indicator.why: the gap the list leaves while pulled, holding the spinner

pulling.why: faint while the pull is short of the threshold

ready.why: full once the pull is past the threshold or the refresh is running

button.why: a Refresh button kept for keyboards and switches, shown when focused

focus-visible.why: the Refresh button shows itself with a focus ring

block-size.why: the gap eases back at press pace, the same in every theme and on every scene
